name: PR416 close-chance retirement evidence

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-close-chance-retirement
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-close-chance-retirement.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  close-chance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-close-chance-retirement
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run exact close-chance predicate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=sim_match_engine_close_chance"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"
